hooks.command: { f=$(grep -oE '"file_path"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"[^"]*"' | head -1 | sed -E 's/.*"file_path"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"([^"]*)".*/\1/'); case "$f" in *.nix) d=$(dirname "$f"); while [ "$d" != / ] && [ ! -e "$d/flake.nix" ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; [ -e "$d/flake.nix" ] && (cd "$d" && nix fmt "$f"); esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
